description: Transport properties and surface tension of water and steam. Coefficients transcribed from the IAPWS releases below, as used by Whb.Core since 2026-08. The critical enhancement terms of both transport releases are NOT included: the formulations here are the background values, which is what a WHB needs away from the critical point.

viscosity.standard: IAPWS R12-08 (2008), dilute-gas and residual terms, no critical enhancement

conductivity.standard: IAPWS R15-11 (2011), dilute-gas and residual terms, no critical enhancement

surfaceTension.standard: IAPWS R1-76(2014): sigma = B tau^mu (1 + b tau), tau = 1 - T/Tc
